summary.name: 钉钉 (DingTalk)
summary.one_liner: DingTalk is Alibaba's enterprise mobile office platform for team communication, collaboration, and business app development, with a free personal tier and a paid 365 membership.
summary.what_it_does: The page describes DingTalk as an enterprise mobile office platform from Alibaba for organizational collaboration and application development. Personal and small-team plans include an AI personal assistant, AI search that integrates chat, documents and logs, AI auto-replies, and AI virtual backgrounds for video meetings. Paid enterprise tiers add larger enterprise storage and meeting minutes, Office suite, attendance, HR and OA approval features, and higher workflow execution limits. The page also lists industry solutions such as low-code app building, sales/customer service (CRM), training, finance/expense control, performance management and ERP-style supply chain tools from partner products.
notable: Free standard tier for individuals and small teams, with a paid 365 membership at ¥19/month (¥15/month on a continuous monthly plan promo)
Claims 27 million+ enterprise organizations and 700 million users
Security certifications listed: ISO 27001:2013 and China Ministry of Public Security level-3 information system protection (等保三级)
Marketplace of industry add-ons such as 氚云 low-code, 酷学院 training, 销帮帮 CRM, and 合思费控 expense management
caveats: Many enterprise features and promotional credits (千问办公积分) are tied to paid tiers or limited-time offers
Partner add-on products are priced separately, starting from roughly ¥800 to ¥7,200 per year
Page is largely marketing; exact platform list (desktop, iOS, Android) is not stated beyond 'mobile' and web context
